verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs include a procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden on your own Linux server. The API docs also reference a self-hosted instance URL (your.domain.com/api/docs), so the official server is designed to run on user infrastructure. Community self-hosting praise is about the third-party Vaultwarden and is not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth evidence on feature parity or licensing requirements for self-hosted deployments, other deployment targets beyond Linux, independent hands-on corroboration of running the official self-hosted server

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
